cues.title: Introducing
cues.note: [The explosion lands in the true-story joke and Aloha.]

cues.title: Your machine
cues.note: Meet your C-arm. With a little more personality.

cues.title: Disconnected
cues.note: Offline? Ghosted.

cues.title: Overdue
cues.note: Patch overdue? It has needs. And firmware.

cues.title: Updating
cues.note: Updating. Its personal-growth era.

cues.title: Happy
cues.note: Connected and current. Thriving.

cues.title: Failed
cues.note: Something fails? You see it.

cues.title: Recovering
cues.note: Recovery gets a character too.

cues.title: The switch
cues.note: [Let the character loop and TV shutdown play.]

cues.title: Now
cues.note: Now, give that personality a nervous system.

cues.title: The day
cues.note: The hospital has a plan. Reality keeps changing it.

cues.title: Search
cues.note: Our scouts evaluate candidate windows across the actual prototype rules.

cues.title: Challenge
cues.note: They check case conflicts, recovery margin, emergency demand, backup coverage and an available human.

cues.title: The window
cues.note: The strongest eligible candidate becomes a clear proposal.

cues.title: Reality changes
cues.note: Before anything starts, an emergency changes the plan. Care comes first.

cues.title: Replan
cues.note: The trauma equipment stays available. The search finds an alternative.

cues.title: A new proposal
cues.note: This is a fresh proposal for review. The emergency never becomes an excuse to bypass approval.

cues.title: Connected intelligence
cues.note: Hospital signals feed the plan. Tested rules contain it.

cues.title: Accountability
cues.note: One person owns the decision.

cues.title: Physical help
cues.note: Connected equipment uses the approved service path. Our robot concept brings power and data where that connection is missing.

cues.title: Follow-through
cues.note: Results and exceptions return to the team. The browser prototype runs the planning logic; hospital and hardware integration are the next step.

cues.title: Our promise
cues.note: Intelligence that follows through.

cues.title: The outcome
cues.note: Let care keep moving. [Hold.]
